feeds.title: The Frolicking Fairy Blogs » Fairy Notes
feeds.description: We provide all the fairy notes. The Frolicking Fairy is a handmade paper craft business bringing whimsy and creativity with unique cards and themed collections. The author wanted to name the entire venture The Farting Gnome. However, upon reflection, that farting little fellow became the alter ego of my sweeter Frolicking Fairy brand. Her goal is to offer you a peek inside her creative process and keep you coming back for more with her unique and fun-loving collections!

feeds.title: Shanda McCloskey Blog
feeds.description: My name is Shanda, and I write and illustrate children's books. I also love visiting schools and talking with kids about robots, and drones, and creating stories with words and pictures. On my blog, you can find out about art, books, fairy tales, and many more!

feeds.title: Fairytalenight.com
feeds.description: My name is Patrick and I am excited to present fairytalenight.com to you. The idea of fairytalenight.com is to handpick beautiful, traditional fairytales or folktales from all around the world and promote them. If you truly want to indulge in the art and beauty of fairytales and folk tales, I would suggest you find out about The birth of the fairytale, a poetic explanation of how fairytales came into our world.

feeds.title: StoryBerries » All Fairy Tales
feeds.description: Bedtime stories, fairy tales, short stories for kids, and poems for kids on Story Berries! Read the Brothers Grimm, Hans Christian Andersen, and magical folk tales, and find all your favorite fairy tale characters! Founded to create large, easily- accessible, of Free to read-quality stories, poems, fairy tales, and comics for children!

feeds.title: Fairy Tales Explored Blog
feeds.description: Fairy Tales Explored Blog is a fairy tale blog which explores all the things about fairy tales! I'm Dana Del George, I enjoy tracing the influence of fairy tales in magical realist short fiction, including the stories of Gabriel García Márquez and George Saunders. I like comic relief in a challenging story, so I appreciate the humor often found in fairy tales.

feeds.title: The Fairy Tale Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Kate Wolford has offered fairy tale lovers a space to publish their tales, read the classics again, and enjoy classic fairy tale art through Enchanted Conversation (now known as The Fairy Tale Magazine). This is a site for fairy tale lovers, creators, and dreamers.

feeds.title: Pook Press Blog
feeds.description: Illustration blog and fortnightly fairy tales from Pook Press. On our blog, you can find new releases from the Pook Press, browse our bestsellers, Venture Down the Rabbit Hole With Alice in Wonderland, deluxe art books, Discover the Origins of Fairy Tales from Around the World, and many others.

feeds.title: Snow White Writes » Fairy Tales
feeds.description: Find Fairy Tales & Writing Inspiration for Snow White Writes. If you're wondering who Snow White is, my name is Sara. I write retold fairy tales for young adults. This blog is a culmination of my lifelong love of fairy tales and my desire to document my publishing journey. If you'd like me to write about a specific tale, explore a topic.

feeds.title: Fairytalez.com Blog
feeds.description: Read insightful and inspiring articles about fairy tales, folk tales, and folklore on FairyTalez Blog. We are now one of the largest collections of fairy tales, folk tales, and fables online. We scour the archives for great tales and share them not only here, but also in our books and audiobook apps.

feeds.title: The Fairy Tale Fair Blog
feeds.description: Read our blog interviews with our designers and makers, vintage sellers, Brighton news, and craft industry posts. The Fairy Tale Fair Handmade Craft & Wedding Fairs in Brighton, Sussex, and now online! See our fairs page for details of our upcoming fairs and events.

feeds.title: Merveilles en Papier Blog
feeds.description: Merveilles en Papier Blog is a Fairy Tale blog. I'm a french Paper Magician. I share my dreams, teach paper magic and techniques, and created among other things Dollhouses, characters inspired by fairy Tales, and all sort of carriages since 2003. Paper is a never-ending inspiration and joy for me.

feeds.title: Fairy Tales Bedtime Stories
feeds.description: Fairy tales, bedtime stories, and short stories for kids, fables on Fairy Tales Bedtime Stories! Read the most beautiful fairy tales and bedtime stories from authors such as the Brothers Grimm, Hans Christian Andersen, O. Henry, Charles Dickens, and more.

feeds.title: Seven Miles of Steel Thistles
feeds.description: Seven Miles of Steel Thistles is a blog about folklore and fairy tales. Find stories about Uncanny Whistlers, The Two Sisters and the Curse, Defending VILLETTE, and more. You can also find the book trailers, all the fairytale reactions, a series of strong fairytale heroines, and more!

feeds.title: The Princess Blog
feeds.description: The Princess Blog is your resource for all things princess! I'm Lisa Dawn, I have always dreamed of being a writer and creating the next great fairy tale princess heroine. Princesses inspire us to be our best selves.

feeds.title: SurLaLune Fairy Tales Blog
feeds.description: SurLaLune Fairy Tales is a fairytale blog consisting of articles like 25 Years of Ella Enchanted by Gail Carson Levine, Insights for Andersen's The Red Shoes: The people who 'danced themselves to death by Rosalind Jana, Insights into The Six Swans: 'Why you should embrace stinging nettles' by Richard Fisher, Four Bargain Ebooks: Pax Arcana Series by Elliott James, and many more!

feeds.title: SJC100 Fairy Tales
feeds.description: SJC100 Fairy Tales is a fairy tale blog which informs on categories like the history of fairy tales, animals, children, images from Pinterest, the magic of Lotte Reiniger, informing about fairy tales from around the world, and more!

feeds.title: Australian Fairy Tale Society Blog
feeds.description: Australian Fairy Tale Society explores the term 'fairy tale' broadly as a living entity that is not exclusively European nor limited to children and encourages you to read our definition of what is a fairy tale. We aim to encourage academics, writers, artists, performers, and enthusiasts from around the country to network and share all things fairy tales through a national website, annual conferences, and local fairy tale rings.

feeds.title: Foxes and Fairy Tales
feeds.description: Find one of the best book reviews and recommendations on Foxes and Fairy Tales! We provide articles like Top Ten Favourite Words, Top Ten Books with Murder, ARC Review: Lavender House, Top Ten Spooky Books on my TBR, and many more!

feeds.title: Fairytale Town Blog
feeds.description: Fairytale Town is a nonprofit park dedicated to promoting the imagination, creativity, and education of children. We've offered children and families a safe place to imagine, play and learn. With 26 playsets based on nursery rhymes and fairytales, a friendly flock of farm animals, two performing arts stages, and several gardens, learning has never been more fun!

feeds.title: BookBunnies » Fairy Tales
feeds.description: Posts about fairy tales written by Book Bunnies. Sprinkles, Marshmallow, and Caramel enjoy reading and started this blog in February 2019 to share their love of books. Marshmallow is planning to post her reviews every Saturday while Caramel will post his reviews on Wednesdays.

feeds.title: Oz & Ends Blog
feeds.description: Musings about some of my favorite fantasy literature for young readers, comics old and new, the peculiar publishing industry, the future of books, kids today, and the writing process. Oz & Ends is a fairy tale blog by J. L. BELL, a writer and reader of fantasy literature for children.

feeds.title: A Modern Day Fairy Tale
feeds.description: I'm Randi- a Christian, a military wife, a mom of two, a Bible journaler, and a lover of books. A Modern Day Fairy Tale is about all of these things and so much more. From recipes and crafts to reviews and giveaways, you'll find it all here!

feeds.title: Fairy Tale Review
feeds.description: On Fairy Tale Review Browse submissions from past editions, web exclusive content, author Q&A, and more. It is an annual literary journal dedicated to publishing new fairy tales and helping raise public awareness of fairy tales as a diverse, innovative art form.

feeds.title: Andrea Bethke Fairytale Club Blog
feeds.description: Andrea Bethke's Fairytale Club is a paper crafting membership club where planners and scrapbookers can create beautiful things and be creative and inspired and work with a new, magical collection every couple of months or so! The Club is made to encourage its members to believe in themselves and to write their own 'happily ever afters'.

feeds.title: Nina Clare Books Blog
feeds.description: Find reviews of fairy tale novels on Nina Clare Books Blog! You can find reviews of the historical events of FREDERICA, VENETIA, a review of The Foundling by Georgette Heyer, a review of The Grand Sophy by Georgette Heyer, and many more!

feeds.title: Fairy Tale News
feeds.description: Fairy tale news from everywhere around the globe, with an emphasis on pop culture & current events. Gypsy is the Creator and Editor of Once Upon A Blog: Fairy Tale News. It focuses on the use of fairy tales all over the globe, with an emphasis on pop culture and current events.

feeds.title: The Multicolored Diary
feeds.description: The Multicolored Diary is by Zalka Csenge Virág, a storyteller from Hungary who explains her wanderings, musings, and adventures. NGO that works to improve the living conditions of people in situations of vulnerability

feeds.title: A Cat, A Book and A Cup of Tea » Fairy Tale
feeds.description: Posts about fairy tales written by Asha - A Cat, A Book, And A Cup Of Tea. The author, Asha, provides book reviews on all the books, tags and fun, author's notes on a lot of things, and many more!

feeds.title: Ty Hulse
feeds.description: Analysis, art, and stories of the world's fairies and fairy tales. I seek to understand fairy tales and the people who told them through the context of religion and culture because this is a large part of where fairy tales come from. I added to my knowledge of fairy tales with a second degree in animation which I used to help tell stories of the fairies I research.

feeds.title: Enchanted Conversation Blog
feeds.description: Enchanted Conversation Blog explores and informs all about fairy tale books and also provides book reviews. It is a Fairy Tale Magazine, that has offered fairy tale lovers a space to publish their tales, read the classics again, and enjoy classic fairy tale art. It's a site for fairy tale lovers, creators, and dreamers.

feeds.title: Magical Fairy Tale Blog
feeds.description: Writing and exploring stories with fairy tale inspirations on Magical Fairy Tale Blog! It issues book reviews on Dark Room Etiquette by Robin Roe, Blood Debts by Terry J Benton-Walker, The Haunting of Alejandra by V. Castro, Don't Think, Dear by Alice Robb, Hex Appeal by Kate Johnson, and many more!
